notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only source is the tnlandforms.us list (row GA164, page marked 2016). The record is not in the cached NHLR or FFLOS Georgia folders (data/raw/nhlr/nhlr.org/lookouts/us/ga and data/raw/fflos/firetower.org/lookouts/us/ga). Live nhlr.org and firetower.org fetches failed with connection resets, so retry those before publishing. Brief status and access remain unknown. Two WebSearch queries and a check of the Knoxville, Georgia Wikipedia page found no tower. The codes are copied as printed and not interpreted. The list's elevation column has no unit on the page, so the story gives 697 without one; feet is likely but not stated. Fact-check pass 2026-10-21: removed the unstated feet and metre conversion, and reworded the 'Many were scrapped and sold' sentence. The story is about 115 words, short of the 120-word target, because the sources support no more.
